defaultModel:
{{
  ({
    userEmail:
      appsmith.store.userEmail || "",

    userRole:
      appsmith.store.userRole || "",

    queries:
      encodeURIComponent(
        JSON.stringify(
          q_ws_list_queries.data || []
        )
      ),

    targets:
      JSON.stringify(
        q_ws_list_targets.data || []
      ),

    sources:
      JSON.stringify(
        q_ws_list_sources.data || []
      ),

    sourcePlatforms:
      JSON.stringify(
        q_ws_list_source_platforms.data || []
      ),

    sourceTotalCount:
      Number(
        (
          (
            q_ws_list_sources.data || []
          )[0] || {}
        ).total_count || 0
      ),

    sourcePage:
      1,

    sourcePageSize:
      25,

    sourceSearch:
      "",

    sourcePlatformFilter:
      "",

    sourceStatusFilter:
      "",

    sourceFormPlatform:
      "",

    sourceFormHandle:
      "",

    sourceFormExternalId:
      "",

    sourceActionId:
      "",

    selectedQueryId:
      CW_Workspace.model.selectedQueryId ||
      CW_Workspace.model.activeQueryId ||
      "",

    selectedQueryName:
      CW_Workspace.model.selectedQueryName ||
      CW_Workspace.model.activeQueryName ||
      "",

    activeQueryId:
      CW_Workspace.model.activeQueryId ||
      "",

    constructor_mode:
      "home",

    constructor_step:
      0,

    query_name:
      "",

    query_status:
      "active",

    query_formula:
      "",

    query_use_web:
      false,

    query_groups_json:
      "[]",

    query_target_ids_json:
      "[]",

    ai_instruction:
      "",

    ai_response:
      encodeURIComponent(
        JSON.stringify(
          Object.assign(
            {
              _nonce:
                (
                  appsmith.store.wsAiResponseEnvelope ||
                  {}
                ).nonce || 0
            },
            (
              appsmith.store.wsAiResponseEnvelope ||
              {}
            ).response || {}
          )
        )
      ),

    ai_proposal_json:
      "{}",

    ai_explanation:
      "",

    ai_generated:
      false,

    query_max_groups:
      3,

    queries_page_size:
      4,

    drawerPosts:
      Q_DrawerPosts.data || [],

    drawerAnalytics:
      (
        (
          Q_DrawerAnalytics.data || []
        )[0] || {}
      ).payload || {},

    openPostUrl:
      ""
  })
}}
